title: Core concepts
description: Design a production AI platform from requirements to recovery.

lessons.title: Requirements, gateways & serving
lessons.description: Design a production AI platform from requirements to recovery.
lessons.conceptOverview: Translate users into request rate, token rate and concurrency using workload assumptions. Gateways enforce authentication, tenant quotas and model routing. Queues absorb bursts but add waiting time; streaming reduces perceived delay without reducing total generation work. GPU scheduling must account for prefill and decoding workloads.

lessons.title: Retrieval, caching & tenancy
lessons.description: Design a production AI platform from requirements to recovery.
lessons.conceptOverview: A production RAG service includes ingestion, object storage, metadata databases, vector indexes and authorization-aware retrieval. Cache keys need model/version, prompt and tenant scope. Semantic caches can return inappropriate answers if similarity ignores permissions or freshness. Rate limits and backpressure protect shared resources.

lessons.title: Reliability, cost & capstones
lessons.description: Design a production AI platform from requirements to recovery.
lessons.conceptOverview: Define availability targets, recovery time and acceptable data loss. Observe latency percentiles, errors, token usage and queue depth. Capacity planning uses measured throughput at the target latency. Failover may change model behavior, so fallback quality needs testing alongside infrastructure recovery.
